fundamentals.name: Data Structures
fundamentals.reason: Essential for solving coding interview questions and writing efficient backend code.

fundamentals.name: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
fundamentals.reason: Core paradigm used across backend languages; important for code organization and design.

fundamentals.name: Debugging
fundamentals.reason: Fundamental day-to-day skill for diagnosing and fixing issues quickly.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: Python
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: High-velocity backend language with strong ecosystem; good for APIs and rapid development.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: FastAPI (Python web framework)
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: Modern, minimal and fast framework for building REST APIs; quicker to learn and deploy than larger frameworks.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: JavaScript (basic / Node.js awareness)
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: Useful for scripting, reading frontend code, and understanding full-stack interactions; basic Node.js knowledge helps with API debugging and interviews.

databases.name: SQL (relational DB fundamentals)
databases.reason: Core skill for interacting with relational databases and answering interview questions about queries and joins.

databases.name: PostgreSQL
databases.reason: Reliable open-source relational DB; great choice for learning SQL and deploying real apps.

databases.name: Redis (basic caching/session use)
databases.reason: Useful lightweight tool for caching and session handling — important conceptually for performant backends.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: Git
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Essential for collaborative development, branching workflows and demonstrating code history.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: GitHub (platform basics)
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Common repository hosting and PR workflow used in interviews and real teams; includes Actions for simple CI.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: CI/CD (basic pipelines)
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Understand basic automated testing and deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) to deliver production-ready code.

testing_and_debugging.name: Unit Testing
testing_and_debugging.reason: Critical for code reliability; practice using pytest/unittest in Python for backend components.

testing_and_debugging.name: Software testing (basics)
testing_and_debugging.reason: Understand test types (unit/integration) and writing testable code — improves interview demos and code quality.

api_and_networking.name: REST APIs
api_and_networking.reason: Primary API style for backend services; build, document and test at least one REST service (FastAPI).

api_and_networking.name: API concepts (auth, status codes, versioning)
api_and_networking.reason: Essential practical knowledge for designing and consuming APIs in interviews and projects.

api_and_networking.name: Microservices (conceptual)
api_and_networking.reason: Conceptually important for modern backends — understand trade-offs and how services communicate, but avoid deep distributed-systems implementation in 3 months.

deployment_and_cloud.name: Docker
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Containerization skill necessary for packaging and running apps consistently in dev and production.

deployment_and_cloud.name: AWS (fundamentals)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Learn core services (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, and simple app deployment) to deploy a backend app; one cloud provider is sufficient initially.

architecture_and_design.name: Software Architecture (basics)
architecture_and_design.reason: High-level design patterns and trade-offs (monolith vs microservices, layering) help craft interview system-design answers.

architecture_and_design.name: Software Design (patterns/principles)
architecture_and_design.reason: Common design patterns (factory, repository) and SOLID principles are widely asked in interviews and needed in real projects.

data_and_ai_integration.name: Logging / Monitoring (concepts)
data_and_ai_integration.reason: Basic observability (logs, metrics) is necessary to operate services and demonstrate production awareness in interviews.

security_and_scalability.name: Caching and performance basics (Redis concept)
security_and_scalability.reason: Understanding caching strategies and when to use Redis improves app performance and systems answers in interviews.

security_and_scalability.name: Scalability concepts (horizontal vs vertical scaling, stateless services)
security_and_scalability.reason: High-level knowledge helps in system design interviews and building resilient services.

communication.name: Clear written and verbal communication
communication.reason: Critical for code reviews, documentation, interview performance and teamwork.

project_management.name: Agile fundamentals
project_management.reason: Understand sprint cycles, user stories and standups — common team workflow that interviewers expect familiarity with.

project_management.name: Jira (basic)
project_management.reason: Common tool for tracking work; knowing basic workflows is helpful but not essential to master in-depth immediately.

problem_solving.name: Interview problem-solving mindset
problem_solving.reason: Practice translating problems into algorithms, writing clear code, and explaining trade-offs — key to landing offers.
